faq.q1: How does IPTV Netherlands activation work?
faq.a1: Once your order is confirmed on WhatsApp, you receive your credentials (server, username, password, M3U / Xtream link) and free IBO Player activation in less than 15 minutes.
faq.q2: Which devices are compatible with the IPTV service?
faq.a2: IPTV Netherlands is 100% compatible with Smart TV (Samsung, LG, Sony), Amazon Firestick, MAG boxes, Android Box, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Android smartphones, Windows PC, and Mac.
faq.a3: A minimum speed of 12 Mbps is recommended for HD channels, 25 Mbps for 4K Ultra HD, and 50 Mbps for 8K without buffering.
faq.q4: Do you offer a refund if I am not satisfied?

faq.q5: Can I use my subscription on multiple screens?

guidePage.title: IPTV Netherlands Installation Guide —
guidePage.subtitle: Install your IPTV Netherlands subscription on all devices in minutes. Follow our simple tutorial to set up IBO Player Pro on Samsung, LG, Firestick, and Android TV.
guidePage.steps_header: 4 Simple Steps To Activate IBO Player:
guidePage.s1_text: On your Smart TV (Samsung, LG), Firestick, Android TV, or Apple device (iOS / Apple TV), open the official App Store and search for 'IBO Player Pro'.
guidePage.s1_bp1: Search 'IBO Player Pro' in your TV store
guidePage.s1_bp2: Download and install the official app
guidePage.s1_bp3: Open IBO Player to view your unique credentials
guidePage.s2_title: Get MAC Address and Device Key
guidePage.s2_text: Launch IBO Player. On the home screen, find the info displayed at the top or in Settings / Device Info: the MAC Address and Device Key.
guidePage.s2_bp1: Note down the MAC Address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF)
guidePage.s2_bp2: Note down the Device Key provided by the app
guidePage.s2_bp3: Keep this screen open on your TV
guidePage.s3_text: Simply send us your MAC Address and Device Key via our dedicated WhatsApp support. Our team directly activates your M3U / XC API link on IBO Player servers.
guidePage.s3_bp2: Send your MAC Address and Device Key
guidePage.s3_bp3: Instant activation by support in < 15 minutes
guidePage.s4_text: Once activation confirmation is received on WhatsApp, simply restart the IBO Player app on your TV. Your live TV channel list and VOD are ready!
guidePage.s4_bp1: Close then reopen IBO Player Pro
guidePage.s4_bp2: Your 4K channels and VOD lists load automatically
guidePage.s4_bp3: Enjoy your 12-month guaranteed IPTV Netherlands subscription!
guidePage.cta_desc: Our support team is available on WhatsApp 24/7 to guide you step-by-step during television setup.
guidePage.fq1: How to install IPTV on Samsung / LG Smart TV?
guidePage.fa1: Access official store, search 'IBO Player Pro', install app then send us your MAC Address and Device Key on WhatsApp for instant activation.
guidePage.fq2: How to install IPTV on Amazon Firestick?
guidePage.fa2: On your Amazon Fire TV Stick, open Appstore, search 'IBO Player' or use Downloader app to install official APK version. Send us your credentials for activation.
guidePage.fq3: What is the activation time after payment?
guidePage.fa3: Activation is quasi-instant, usually within 15 minutes of receiving your WhatsApp message.
guidePage.fq4: Can I install IBO Player on multiple devices?
guidePage.fa4: You can install the app on all screens (Smart TV, Smartphone, Tablet, PC), but simultaneous usage depends on your plan's connection limit.
